lessons.lesson: Extreme fear (Fear & Greed below 25) is followed by BTC/ETH being higher a week later more often than not: crowds sell in panic, prices rebound.
lessons.source: Common contrarian belief; untested here. Evidence on sentiment indices is mixed.
